essence: The flag-raising and preliminary rites should be performed according to the wish of the performer.
The rite must be accompanied by the auspicious eight verses as prescribed for one's own class.
One should give an offering to Indra and others accompanied by fragrance, flowers, and so forth.
The sacrificial hall should be constructed according to rule and furnished with an altar.
One should perform the auspicious sprout rite endowed with all auspicious elements.
